requirement: core 1.0GB installed target; optional up to 5.0GB of app-managed data; combined nominal 6.0GB

tasks.name: Define measured core and optional footprint
tasks.acceptance: Document accounting categories; use actual on-device APIs to distinguish APK/core, mutable user data, extra packs and OS overhead; no false 1GB installed claim.

tasks.name: Design safe offline optional pack manifest and storage host
tasks.acceptance: Pack IDs, hashes, schema, compatibility, app-private installation plus user-chosen local SAF import; core playable offline without optional packs; no generic storage permission.

tasks.name: Implement explicit quota and low-space guards
tasks.acceptance: Optional <=5e9 bytes, managed total <=6e9 bytes, free-after-write >= max(500MB, 10% currently free); account for temporary peak and failure rollback; never auto reserve full 5GB.

tasks.name: Add user-facing storage manager with safe remove/export
tasks.acceptance: Display actual core/optional/free values, user confirmation for installing/removing packs, prevent deletion of saves, transactional update and backup safety.

tasks.name: Automated boundary tests and Android storage QA
tasks.acceptance: Offline core/optional=0, GB/GiB conversions, corrupt/oversized pack, exact quotas, disk-full mid-write, migration and real device measurements or explicit hardware blocker.
